description: Defines a single result of an analysis. Used for laboratory or similar analyses.

name.description: Human readable description of the metric.

characteristic.description: The characteristic of the metric, often an abbreviation.

metric.description: The metric that this result represents. See well-known/icarMetricType.md and well-known/icarMilkMetrics.md

method.description: The test method employed. Where feasible, use a URI to source specification or standard.

rawValue.description: Value of the test result as supplied before standardising to ICAR standard units

rawUnit.description: Units of the test result as supplied before standardising to ICAR standard units

value.description: Value of the test result converted to standard units

displayUnit.description: The unit of the test result as displayed to users, which may differ from UN/CEFACT or SI names.

unit.description: Units of the value, standardised using UN/CEFACT by ICAR convention.

denominatorUnit.description: Units of the denominator for the metric, standardised using UN/CEFACT by ICAR convention, if applicable.

resolution.description: The smallest measurement difference that can be discriminated by the analyser. Specified in Units, for instance 0.5 (kilograms).

qualitativeGrade.description: A textual or descriptive grade for the result.

limit.description: Numeric threshold of limit used with statuses 'belowLimit' and 'aboveLimit'
